comments.author: ShearedLugs
comments.body_html:
Day 43

My soul is still trapped inside of this mannequin. I am utterly fatigued from the constant dance spell I’ve been put under, my will to go on is shattered. A mortar strike has since knocked me on my side, in which I am thankful, for the zabralo on my torso has over time grown more and more burdensome. Still, yet, I move in a dance, and in some points of the cycle I balance upon an elbow, or a fist, to my immense discomfort.

What wizard plucked me from my slumber, to entrap a soul to this hell?
